newsitem.title: USA: EMPIRE SEEKS RATE INCREASE IN MISSOURI.
newsitem.headline: EMPIRE SEEKS RATE INCREASE IN MISSOURI.

text.p: Empire District Electric Co said Wednesday it has filed a request for new rates for its Missouri electric customers with the Missouri Public Service Commission.

The request was for an annual increase in revenues of $3.3 million, or 1.9 percent, which would result in an increase of about $0.98 in the monthly bill of a residential customer using 700 kilowatt hours.
The request comes immediately following the company's rate case that became effective Tuesday in which rate recovery for its investment in Unit II at the State Line Power Plant was denied.
The company said it has asked the commission to not suspend the rates that were filed Wednesday, but to allow them to go into effect on Sept. 5.
